title: update...values expressions are lost due to differences in how insert/update handle these keys
body:
### Describe the bug

I have been trying to perform a bulk update using `connection.execute` and values added as a connection parameter. The update is conditional, some of the values are nullable and can either be null in the update value _or_ in the existing value, in which case I want to choose the non-NULL value, using `func.COALESCE`. Unfortunately, the coalesce statement appears to be dropped when passing the update `stmt` to `connection.execute`.

I am able to work around the issue by passing `text(str(stmt))` instead of `stmt`.

### To Reproduce

```python
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, insert, update, select, bindparam, func, text


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass

class Foo(Base):
    __tablename__ = "Foo"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    number: Mapped[int]
    optional_number: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(default=None)


engine=create_engine('sqlite://',echo=True)

Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

with engine.connect() as connection:
    connection.execute(
        insert(Foo),
        [
            {"id":1, "number": 1, "optional_number": 1},
            {"id":2, "number": 2, "optional_number": None},
            {"id":3, "number": 3, "optional_number": 3},
        ]
    )
    connection.commit()
    

with engine.connect() as connection:
    vals = connection.execute(
        select(Foo.id, Foo.number, Foo.optional_number).order_by(Foo.id)
    ).tuples().all()

    assert vals == [(1, 1, 1), (2, 2, None), (3, 3, 3)]


updated_values = [
    {"u_id":1, "number": 1, "optional_number": None},
    {"u_id":2, "number": 2, "optional_number": 2},
]

with engine.connect() as connection:
    stmt = update(Foo).where(
            Foo.id == bindparam("u_id")
        ).values(
            number=bindparam("number"),
            optional_number=func.COALESCE(bindparam("optional_number"), Foo.optional_number)
        )

    connection.execute(
        stmt,  # Works: text(str(stmt))
        updated_values
    )
    connection.commit()

with engine.connect() as connection:
    vals = connection.execute(
        select(Foo.id, Foo.number, Foo.optional_number).order_by(Foo.id)
    ).tuples().all()

    assert vals == [(1, 1, 1), (2, 2, 2), (3, 3, 3)]  # Fails, as vals == [(1, 1, None), (2, 2, 2), (3, 3, 3)]
```
